_meta.notes: Every string the interface says in its own voice. Templates use {braces}. The three modes wear verbs, not nouns: Plan, Play, Act, because the loop is the navigation.

landing.q: Eight places you could go after secondary school. How many stay reachable, whatever subjects you pick?
landing.guessHint: Take a guess. Tap a number.
landing.revealAll: All eight. Every one keeps a road to it from any combination.
landing.revealNote: Some roads are longer. None are closed. The engine under this site cannot draw a closed door, and you can check it.

landing.enterPlaySub: Live one life forward, from your own combination
landing.enterActSub: Leave with three things to do this term

load.heavy: That is a heavy load. Four done well beats seven done thinly, at every admission point.
load.solid: A normal load. Is there one in there I took for the look of it?
load.spread: A balanced spread. Depth usually serves people better than a thin layer.
load.early: Still early. Check I have not ruled out something I never tried.

ask.dest: Ask my ECG counsellor: what is {dest} actually like day to day?
ask.aim: Ask an adult who does this: what are the bad days like?

thisYear.sec1: Four subjects can move up at the end of this year. Asking is the whole mechanism.
thisYear.sec2: The big one. Where my levels land this year is what I carry into Sec 3.
thisYear.sec3: My levels are largely set. What I build with them this year is not.
thisYear.sec4: Early Admissions opens before results. What I have made and done counts now.
thisYear.sec5: This year widens what comes next. Aim it at something specific.

journey.asks: This one asks for {disp}. I have {have}.
journey.stretchChip: a stretch for me right now
journey.metChip: I built the footing for this
journey.endWantUnsure: At {age} I said I was not sure yet. That was honest, and it worked.

journey.verdictCombo: Different subjects, different first steps, and I am both holding doors. The combination started the story. It did not finish it.
journey.stoppedNote: {label} stopped at {age}, at the end of the first qualification. A short game is a whole game.

journey.toAct: So what now? Take it to Act
journey.q2: Where do I want to go?

journey.stillTrueNone: At {age} I said I was not sure what I wanted.
journey.efficacyLine: I did the hard one. Now I know I can.
journey.kindsNote: Six kinds of people at work. Most people are a mix of two or three.

journey.doorTag: a door I hold opened this
journey.whyFull: Seven subjects or more is a fuller year.

journey.whyCca: The CCA I give my evenings to takes its share.
journey.whyFreer: More of my time is mine to direct now.
journey.whyWeek: My week outside lessons is a full one.
journey.whyRoom: There is room in my week outside lessons.
journey.whyNs: Service sets the hours this year.

journey.runLong: Keep going, all the way to 48
journey.runPick: How far do I want to play?

journey.tourHead: Three things and I am playing

journey.tour2: Life deals a chance every year. How I answer it is mine.
journey.tour3: Pick everything I want, then tap That is my year once.
journey.nsYes: NS is part of my road
journey.nsNote: Logged, and the story moves on. Nothing else is asked.
journey.weekPaidNote: I carried {what} through this year. That happens whether or not a turn was spent on it.
journey.classSeedHint: If my teacher gave a play code, put it here. The whole class gets the same luck.
journey.possHead: What else is possible from here
journey.possNote: Real routes, with what each one asks for. Nothing here is closed to me.
journey.possMissedHead: Roads that were open the whole time
journey.possMissedNote: These were live in the years I just played. Most of them still are.

journey.mapReflect: Put what I wrote at 38 on the card

journey.cardHint: One picture of this story, made on my device. Share it or keep it.
journey.compareHead1: Same start. One chapter went differently.
journey.compareHeadSame: Same start, and the same choices all the way down.
journey.compareRoads: Two starts that matched, and two roads that did not.
journey.efficacyRisk: More nerve than I had banked. Shaky counts.
journey.efficacyPersistence: I did not have the miles yet. I went anyway.
journey.efficacyCuriosity: I asked before I knew how to ask well. The asking improves.
journey.efficacyFlexibility: I bent further than before. Awkward, and it held.
journey.efficacyOptimism: I backed something I was unsure of. It came out uneven.
journey.efficacyRisk2: Nerve I had not banked yet, spent anyway. That is how it gets banked.
journey.efficacyPersistence2: Nobody had shown me how to keep at that. I kept at it.
journey.efficacyCuriosity2: A clumsy question, and an answer I would not have had.
journey.efficacyFlexibility2: I changed the plan mid year. It cost something, and it moved.
journey.efficacyOptimism2: I acted as if it would work out. Half of it did.
journey.wantKnown: I already said this in Act
journey.whyGrown: One more every year now, because I {why}.
journey.waitedHead: What this year could not hold
journey.homeQ: One more, if I want. What does home want for me?
journey.homeHint: Nothing is scored on this. Some outcomes will speak to it, that is all.
journey.endHomeSame: Home wanted what I wanted. That helped, and I still did the walking.
journey.endHomeSteady: Home wanted steady and safe. Some years I gave them that, some years I gave them me.
journey.endHomeTheirs: Home had a road picked. This one is mine, and the door home stayed open.
journey.endHomeUnsaid: We never really talked about what home wanted. The story happened anyway. Maybe I show them this.
journey.endHomeSplit: Home never did agree on one answer. I stopped waiting for it and made mine.
journey.friendAlt: A classmate appears through the years
journey.weekRoom: A light week. Next school year gets an extra point of time.
journey.weekSteady: A steady week. My time points stay as they are.
journey.weekFull: A full week. It takes a point of time each school year, and it pays in what it builds.
journey.weekHours: About {n} hours a week outside lessons.
journey.ccaNote: One tap. It shapes my week every school year, and it never spends a point.

teacher.classIntro: Ask each student for their class code, one line each. Nothing is sent anywhere: this runs in your browser and disappears when you close the tab.
teacher.classPunch: Between you, this room already holds {n} of the {total} destinations.
teacher.classAll: Between you, this room already holds every destination on the list.
teacher.classNote: Nobody here holds all of them alone. That is the point worth saying out loud.
teacher.classNone: No codes yet. Paste them above.
teacher.playHead: Class play: same luck for everyone
teacher.playIntro: Generate a play code and read it out. Every student who enters it gets the same chances in the same order, so the debrief compares answers instead of luck.
teacher.playNote: The code seeds the game's randomness and carries nothing else.
teacher.stageIntro: Project this page with board mode on. Ask the room to guess how many of the eight it holds between everyone. Then type each student's class code and press Enter, one at a time, and watch.
teacher.stageOpen: Open this page with board=1 for the stage.
teacher.stagePrompt: Type a class code, press Enter
teacher.stageNobody: Nobody holds all of them alone. Say that out loud.

parentLive.head: What is on this phone
parentLive.none: Nothing set on this device yet. The rest of this page still holds.
parentLive.takes: Your child has set {n} subjects for {year}.
parentLive.opens: With those levels, {n} of the {total} next steps are open to them right now.
parentLive.lever: One change would move {n} of them: {move}.
parentLive.privacy: Subjects only. What they wrote, what they wanted, the stories they played and what they said they carry outside lessons stay theirs, and this page does not show them.
parentLive.askBody: Ask them to show you this screen and talk you through it. Not to justify it. Just to show you.

table.head: The table
table.title: Same years. Same luck. Different choices.
table.lede: Two to six of you, one screen, one lesson. Everybody lives the same chapters off the same shuffled deck, decides in private, and then it all gets laid out side by side.
table.codeNote: The code shuffles the deck. Two tables typing the same code get the same luck, in the same order.
table.privacy: Nothing here is saved or sent. Close the tab and the table is gone.
table.passBody: Hand it on without showing what you picked. The reveal is better when nobody has seen it coming.
table.endSplit: You started together and you are standing in different places.
table.endTogether: You all took the same road, and it did not make you the same.
table.endBody: Nobody won this. There is no score and there was never going to be one. Read across the seats and argue about which life you would rather have.
table.closeBody: Everybody at this table met the same eight destinations. Say out loud which one surprised you, and which one you had written off before today.
table.packNote: Printed from Paths. Nothing on this sheet was sent anywhere.
table.packBoard: The board: eight places to land

prompts.q: Whose choice would your parents have picked for you, and whose would you have picked for yourself?
Somebody at this table spent a year on something nobody can see yet. Which one of you, and was it worth it?
Same card, different answers. Who took the risk, and what did it cost the ones who did not?
One of you holds a door nobody else does. Ask them how they got it, and say whether you would want it.
Who at this table had the hardest year, and what could the rest of you have done about it?
Nobody here took the same road. Say one good thing about the road next to yours.
prompts.cc: Civic, Global and Cross Cultural Literacy

table.askWho: Who is backing you? Each seat has two backs for the whole game.

table.sharedDoors: {n} different doors are open across the table.

table.ccRoads: You walked {n} different roads between you.
table.askSpent: Everyone else has spent both of their backs. This one is yours alone.
